components.name: button
components.title: Button
components.description: The one button for every action. Primary for the main action of a view, secondary for everything else, ghost for low-emphasis actions in toolbars, danger for destructive actions.
components.whenToUse: Any clickable action. Use one primary button per view or dialog. Use an <a class="tx-btn"> only when it navigates.

variants.description: Main action. Brand fill, lifts to the menu-bar colour on hover.
Default action. Card surface, line border, gold on hover.
Low emphasis, no border until hover.
28px high, for tables and dense toolbars.
Full width, for narrow forms and mobile.

components.a11y: Use <button type="button"> (or type="submit" in forms). Icon-only buttons need aria-label. Disabled state uses the disabled attribute, not a class.

components.name: context-bar
components.title: Context bar
components.description: One dark band of key facts about the record being viewed (promotion, market, period, owner), in the menu bar colours, with an optional gold action chip.
components.whenToUse: Top of detail pages (result, workflow, logistics) to keep the record in view. One per page, under the page header.

variants.description: Gold action chip on the right.

components.a11y: Facts are a <dl>: each fact is a <div> with <dt> label and <dd> value.

components.name: data-table
components.title: Data table
components.description: Sticky uppercase header, hairline rows, gold row hover, numeric columns right-aligned. The wrapper scrolls sideways with a visible scrollbar on wide tables.
components.whenToUse: Any tabular data. Put it in a card with tx-card__body--flush, add tx-pagination in the card footer. Use tx-table--dense for long lists and tx-table--lines for column lines.

variants.description: Scrolling frame. Set --tx-table-h to fix the height (sticky header scrolls inside).
Cell class: right-aligned tabular figures (header follows).
First column frozen while scrolling sideways.

components.a11y: Use <th scope="col">. Give the table a <caption> (it can be visually hidden with tx-sr-only). Sortable headers use a button inside the th and aria-sort on the th.
examples: Table in a card with pagination

components.name: kpi-tile
components.title: KPI tile
components.description: A single figure with a micro label and an optional change indicator. Tiles sit in a row inside a summary card.
components.whenToUse: Headline numbers (volume, uplift, budget). Put several in a tx-kpi-row. Tiles inside a summary card are the one allowed exception to 'no box in a box'.

variants.description: Gold top edge, for the one figure that matters most.

components.a11y: Say the direction in words too (for example '+4.2% vs last year'), not only with colour or an arrow.

components.name: empty-state
components.title: Empty state
components.description: Centred icon, one-line title, short help and an optional action, for a list or table with nothing in it yet.
components.whenToUse: No data yet, no search results, or no permission. Say what to do next.

variants.description: Smaller, for inside a table cell or a small card.

components.name: toast
components.title: Toast
components.description: A short message that slides in at the bottom right and fades after a few seconds. Also an inline alert for messages that stay on the page.
components.whenToUse: Toast: confirm an action that happened ('Saved', 'Submitted for approval'). Alert: a message that must stay visible (validation summary, warning about data).

variants.description: JavaScript call; tone is success, danger, info or warning.

components.a11y: The toast region is aria-live="polite". Alerts that need immediate attention use role="alert".

components.name: checkbox
components.title: Checkbox, radio and switch
components.description: Themed checkbox, radio and on/off switch, each with its label in one clickable row.
components.whenToUse: Checkbox for independent options and table row selection; radio for one choice out of a few; switch for a setting that applies at once.

variants.description: Vertical or horizontal group with a legend.

components.a11y: Use native inputs inside a <label>. Group radios in a <fieldset> with a <legend>. A switch is <input type="checkbox" role="switch">.

components.name: field
components.title: Field
components.description: Label, control and help or error text for text inputs, selects, textareas and search boxes. 36px controls with a gold focus ring.
components.whenToUse: Every form control. Wrap the control in tx-field so label, help and error stay consistent. Use tx-field--inline for a label beside the control.

variants.description: Text, number, email, password, date inputs.
Native select with the themed chevron.
Input with a leading icon or a trailing unit.
Red border and message; set aria-invalid on the control.
28px control for tables and dense filters.

components.a11y: Every control has a <label for>. Help and error text are linked with aria-describedby. Required fields use the required attribute and show '*' in the label.

components.name: filter-bar
components.title: Filter bar
components.description: A row of filter fields that grow to fill the width, with the search and reset actions at the end. Wraps on narrow screens.
components.whenToUse: Above a table or list. Inside a card it sits flush with a hairline under it.

variants.description: The fields; each tx-field inside grows from 160px.

components.a11y: Wrap in <form role="search"> when it filters results.

components.name: app-shell
components.title: App shell and menu bar
components.description: The page frame: a dark menu bar on the left (collapsed to 72px, opens in place on hover and pushes the content over, pin button keeps it open), a scrolling main column with tight padding, and a drawer below 900px. The theme picker lives in the menu bar footer.
components.whenToUse: Every app page. Start from ui/patterns/page-template.html rather than writing the shell by hand. Change the brand badge, title and nav items only.

variants.description: Current page in the menu (also set aria-current="page").
Button that opens the colour theme menu (five CXO themes).
Collapsed state, set before first paint by the head script.

components.a11y: The menu bar is an <aside aria-label="Main menu"> with a <nav>. Collapsed items keep their label for screen readers (title + hidden text). Keyboard focus inside the collapsed menu opens it. The drawer closes on Escape.
examples: Menu bar (pinned open; hover peeks when collapsed)

components.name: card
components.title: Card
components.description: The one container for a block of content: a titled section with an optional toolbar, a body and a footer.
components.whenToUse: Every block on a page. One container per block: never put a framed card inside another card. Tables, filter bars and forms inside a card sit flush (their frame is removed automatically).

variants.description: Title row with optional subtitle and actions on the right.
No padding, for tables that run edge to edge.
Slight gradient and deeper shadow, for hero blocks.
A heading for a group of cards, without a frame.

components.a11y: Give the card's title an id and set aria-labelledby on the <section>.

components.name: layout
components.title: Layout helpers and icons
components.description: Stack, row and grid helpers that space components with the spacing tokens, the stroke icon class, and small utilities (screen-reader-only text, muted text, numbers).
components.whenToUse: Spacing between components inside a card or page body. Use these before writing page CSS. Grids collapse to one column below 900px.

variants.description: Auto-fit grid, min column --tx-grid-min (220px); --2 and --3 fixed columns.
Visually hidden, read by screen readers.

components.a11y: Icons inside buttons are aria-hidden; the button carries the label.

components.name: page-header
components.title: Page header
components.description: Breadcrumb, serif page title, a one-line lead and actions on the right. Every page starts with one.
components.whenToUse: Top of every page, first child of tx-main. Put the page's main actions (or a stepper) in tx-page-header__actions. Use tx-kicker for a small gold label above a title.

variants.description: Trail of links; the last item is the current page.
Gold rule and tracked uppercase label above a title.
Buttons or a stepper, aligned to the bottom right; wraps below on narrow screens.

components.a11y: One <h1> per page, here. The breadcrumb is a <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb"> with aria-current="page" on the last item.

components.name: pagination
components.title: Pagination
components.description: Page numbers with previous and next arrows; the current page has a gold border. Wraps on phones.
components.whenToUse: Under a table, usually in the card footer next to a 'Showing x of y' summary.
components.a11y: Wrap in <nav aria-label="Pages">. Mark the current page with aria-current="page". Arrows need aria-label.

components.name: stepper
components.title: Stepper
components.description: Compact step indicator for multi-step flows: done steps show a green check, the current step is a raised pill, upcoming steps are muted.
components.whenToUse: Wizards such as create promotion → configure → simulate → submit. Put it in the page header actions or above the form.
components.a11y: Use an <ol>. Mark the current step with aria-current="step". Done steps can be links back.

components.name: tabs
components.title: Tabs and segmented control
components.description: A tinted track with the active tab raised on the card surface. The same look serves page tabs (switch panels) and segmented controls (switch a view or a filter).
components.whenToUse: Tabs switch between panels of one page. A segmented control switches a view of the same data (Monthly / Quarterly). Up to about 6 options; the track scrolls sideways if it runs out of room.

variants.description: Tab list; panels are tx-tab-panel elements. Behaviour from twinx.js (data-tx-tabs).
Same look, for radio-like view switches.
Underline style for tabs inside a card head.
Small count after a tab label.

components.a11y: role="tablist" / "tab" / "tabpanel" with aria-selected and aria-controls. twinx.js adds arrow-key navigation. A segmented control uses aria-pressed on its buttons.

components.name: modal
components.title: Modal dialog
components.description: Centred card on a dimmed, blurred backdrop with a gold top edge. Built on the native <dialog> element.
components.whenToUse: Confirmations, short forms and details that need focus. Not for long flows (use a page). One primary button in the footer, on the right.

variants.description: Attributes that open and close a dialog with twinx.js, no page script needed.

components.a11y: Native <dialog> with showModal() traps focus and closes on Escape. Give it aria-labelledby pointing at the title.

components.name: tooltip
components.title: Tooltip
components.description: A small dark label under an element on hover and keyboard focus, set with one attribute.
components.whenToUse: Explain an icon-only button or a truncated label. Not for essential information (it is hidden on touch).
components.a11y: Also set aria-label on icon-only buttons; the tooltip is visual only.

components.name: badge
components.title: Badge
components.description: A small tinted pill with a dot that shows a status: approved, pending, in progress, rejected, draft.
components.whenToUse: Statuses in tables, cards and headers. Not for actions (use a button) and not for counts on icons (use tx-count).

variants.description: Round number on an icon button (notifications).

components.a11y: The status must be in the text, never only in the colour.
